name: Geochronology & Thermochronology
summary: How the ages of rocks, minerals, landscapes and events are measured, from relative dating to radiometric and exposure-dating methods.

topics.name: Relative dating: superposition, cross-cutting relations and correlation
Radioactive decay, half-lives and the age equation
U-Pb zircon geochronology and concordia diagrams
Thermochronology: fission track, (U-Th)/He and closure temperature
Incremental methods: dendrochronology, varves and ice layers
Magnetostratigraphy, astrochronology and building the geologic time scale
